name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
description: Gemini 3.7 Flash is Google's fast multimodal model for high-throughput agentic and general-purpose workloads.

details.name: pricing
details.value: $0.75 input, $0.075 cached input, and $3.75 output per 1M tokens at standard rates. Batch and flex are $0.375 input and $1.875 output. Priority is $1.35 input and $6.75 output. Cached-image, Batch video-input, and Priority video-input rates are provisional cross-modality assumptions. Cache storage is $0.50 per 1M token-hours.

page_notice.markdown: We have provisionally added Gemini 3.7 Flash ahead of Google's public launch. Its routes are ready and will come online when Google enables the model. Published pricing is verified against Google Cloud SKUs.

sources.notes: Official global SKUs for standard, batch, flex, priority, cached-input, and cache-storage pricing.
Third-party launch report for model name, expected date, and input/output pricing; cached-input pricing is inferred at the requested 90% discount.

verification.notes: Pricing is verified against official Google Cloud SKUs; model launch details still await official Google confirmation.
